about: H4 blind off-topic set. Authored 2026-10-18 BEFORE any H4 measurement and committed first (docs/phases/16_post_launch_roadmap.md H4 step 1). 20 off-corpus questions a Nigerian user might plausibly type that lie outside the three documents (Disability Act 2018, 1999 Constitution, Factsheet 2020), and 5 near-misses that ARE covered by the corpus but phrased in lay words. Written from the playbook's topic list and general knowledge; no corpus vocabulary or scores were consulted. Read ONCE, after the threshold is frozen on dev. Near-miss refs are NOT asserted ground truth: they are the author's expectation, recorded so a refusal on them is visible.
